audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: Net profit margin for FY2015 is 3.5%
audit_report.rationale: The analyst calculated net profit margins incorrectly. For FY2015: 1233/40339 = 3.06% (not 3.5%). For FY2017: 1228/34903 = 3.52% (not 3.5%). These errors in individual year calculations propagated to an incorrect 3-year average of 3.1% instead of the correct value of approximately 3.1% [(3.06+2.27+3.52)/3 = 2.95%]. The primary error appears in the FY2015 calculation being overstated.
